[{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

The Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering (general option) requires a minimum of 149-174 units consisting of general education, major and graduation requirements. The courses below are recommended in order to fulfill GE requirements and/or upper division course prerequisites for the Mechanical Engineering B.S. non license program only.


The Mechanical Engineering program at the Solano Campus offers a unique educational approach by combining hands-on experiences and math and science-intensive coursework. The mission of the program is to produce entry-level professionals capable of applying their knowledge of science and engineering in the design, analysis, operation, and production of engineering components, systems, and products. Students can choose one of two options under Mechanical Engineering program. The U.S. Coast Guard Third Assistant Engineer License Concentration is for those seeking engineering careers in the maritime industry, both at sea and on land. The General Curriculum is for those interested in applying their maritime experience toward traditional engineering careers.


Mechanical Engineering [Solano Campus] Curriculum

Thank you for your interest in Cal Poly Maritime Academy!

California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo and Cal Poly Maritime Academy has integrated into one university with two locations. Cal Poly Maritime Academy will be known as Solano Campus. Each respective campus will maintain separate assist.org accounts until Fall 2028, when our curriculum is fully integrated.


This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in major and support. Students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer.

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major
  • Admissions website for current transfer admission requirements for Solano campus
  • Cal Poly Maritime Academy website for information for Solano campus 

ACADEMIC INFORMATION

  • Requirements and flowcharts for each major can be viewed on the respective major page, under the requirements tab. Information about concentrations, if applicable, are displayed on this page
  • AP/IB/CLEP credit
  • Academic Advising
  • Transfer Credits at Cal Poly | Cal Poly and Cal Poly Maritime Academy are one university with two locations. There will be two separate Assist.org accounts until Fall 2028, when our curriculum is fully integrated.
